out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager
Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED FOOD STAFF WASH HANDS IN THE PREP-SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. CDI: STAFF MEMBER RE-EDUCATED AND USED THE HANDWASHING SINK TO WASH HANDS. Sushi Prince (Inspection Date: 06/04/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE WAREWASHING AREA TO HAVE CHOPSTICKS AND A SCREWDRIVER IN IT.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: ITEMS REMOVED FROM HANDWASHING SINK AND PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS AVAILABLE AT HANDWASHING SINK IN WAREWASHING AREA AND AT SUSHI LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELL EGGS AND RAW SHRIMP STORED ON A SHELF ABOVE RTE SAUCES IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: RAW FOODS MOVED DURING INSPECTION. ENSURE RETRAINING OF FOOD STAFF.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED ON THE COUNTER BY DEEP FRYERS: SHRIMP TEMPURA AT 89F (1HR), DUMPLINGS AT 59F (1HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: PIC OPTED TO THROW THESE AWAY AT CLOSING AT 2:30PM AND LABELED THEM WITH THE END TIME.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IMITATION CRAB MEAT ON COUNTER AT SUSHI STATION AT 60F (1HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: IMITATION CRAB MEAT PUT IN COOLER AND STAFF RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: OBSERVED SUSHI RICE HELD ON TPHC NOT MARKED WITH END TIME.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CDI: SUSHI RICE MARKED WITH END POINT DURING INSPECTION. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. observed a employee in the kitchen area washing hands while wearing a pair of gloves, not facilitating in proper handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. Person in charge stopped employee and had them discard the gloves and wash hands properly.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: observed sushi rice at the sushi counter was being held out using time as a public health control. Container of sushi rice did not have a time label marking the start and end times.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. Person in charge made time label for the sushi rice. Sushi Prince (Inspection Date: 12/09/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed @ @ stored in such a way that they could contaminate @Equipment@ in the @Location@. observed in hallway, storage first aid medicine and cleaning chemicals, being stored over cans of soda and various dry good foods.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. Person in charge moved the first aid supplies and chemicals away from the dry good foods.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter of the two door prep, top cooler and the sushi counter
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Person in charge had damn towels removed too sanitizer solution buckets.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observe the two door on counter and four door on counter coolers at the sushi station we’re being held together by duct tape
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Person in charge agreed to have duct tape removed and to have the doors for the two door and four door on counter display repaired

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: observed in the kitchen on the cook line, tinfoil and plastic wrap being used as coverings without being changed out every 24 hours
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Person in charge agreed to discontinue use of tinfoil and plastic coverings.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the @Physical structure@ in the @Location@ is in need of cleaning. observed walls in the kitchen being covered in plastic wrap, plastic wrap was not clean to site and touch
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PIC agreed to clean the plastic wrap and have plastic wrap and duct tape taken down from the walls.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the @Physical structure@ is not maintained in good repair. observed duct tape being used to patch holes and walls and hold a plastic wrap.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Person in charge agreed to discontinue use of duct tape as repairs and two officially repair issues so is a smooth and easily cleanable surface.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed handwashing sink in the KITCHEN area being used for storage of gloves.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC removed boxes of gloves from handwashing sink.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: EHS observed thawing ROP shrimp, yellowtail, imitation crab, tuna, and other ROP fish in the walk in cooler being thawed in fully sealed ROP packaging
violations.corrective_action: EHS reviewed ROP packaging with PIC, PIC opened all thawing ROP fish packaging.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: observed the counter sushi cooler on the left of the counter did not have an in unit thermometer
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC replaced the in unit thermometer

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Rear Door is kept open for ventilation and opening is not protected by a screen or other effective means in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Provide screens (16 mesh to 1 inch), air curtains, or other effective means to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. PIC closed door, agreed to install an effective bug screen if they are going to keep the door open for ventilation. Sushi Prince (Inspection Date: 06/23/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: EHS observed plastic sheeting and aluminum ventilation tape on the walls of the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS spoke to PIC about issue, PIC agreed to repair walls by next inspection, so they could be considered smooth and easily cleanable surfaces.

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises in the rear of the kitchen area
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. EHS asked PIC to clean up and get rid of unnecessary equipment by next inspection

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floors and ceilings of the kitchen is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS asked PIC to deep clean the facility by next inspection, PIC agreed to clean.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: EHS OBSERVED SUSHI RICE INTENDED FOR DINNER SERVICE AT 121F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. SUSHI RICE WAS MOVED TO TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL, AS EXACT PREP TIME WAS KNOWN.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: EHS OBSERVED VACUUM SEALED PACKAGES OF VARIOUS FISHES THAWING IN WALK IN COOLER WITHOUT VENT IN PACKAGING.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC CUT VENTS IN ALL PACKAGES OF THAWING FISH.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS. EHS OBSERVED NUMEROUS SEAWEED SALAD MANUFACTURERS CONTAINERS USED FOR THE STORAGE OF VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC WILL OBTAIN SUFFICIENT, APPROVED STORAGE FOR ALL FOOD ITEMS. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
